vocab_words.example: We have a two-hour layover in Singapore.
Submit your receipts for reimbursement by Friday.
Please have your boarding pass ready at the gate.
The flight delay caused him to miss the connection.
The train fare has increased this year.
All passengers must pass through customs.
Please send the invoice to the accounting department.
Revenue increased by ten percent last quarter.
The report lists all expenditures for the project.
An external audit will be conducted next month.

items.question: If the shipment ___ on time, we will lose the client.
items.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, mệnh đề chính dùng will.

items.question: The client was pleased ___ the quality of the final product.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be pleased with something".

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: The report should be submitted ___ the end of the fiscal year.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần nộp trước một mốc thời gian, dùng "before".

items.question: The department head ___ several changes to improve efficiency.
items.explanation: Câu cần động từ chia ở thì hiện tại hoàn thành để diễn tả hành động vừa xảy ra.

items.question: The manager asked her assistant ___ the documents before the meeting.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "ask someone to do something".

items.question: The negotiation process took longer ___ anyone had anticipated.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn dùng "than", không phải "then".

items.question: The new regulations ___ affect small businesses more than large corporations.
items.explanation: Trạng từ "likely" thường đứng giữa trợ động từ "will" và động từ chính.

items.question: The report contains ___ information than we expected.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn với danh từ không đếm được "information" dùng "more".

items.question: The manager insisted that the report ___ revised before submission.
items.explanation: Sau "insist that" trong câu giả định trang trọng, dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".
